QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Supply Run
QuestInfo.0: Go see #bHarpoon#k at the #bReclamation HQ#k and hear about the situation.
QuestInfo.1:
Harpoon asked you to get #b10 Dinogoth Tails#k for the starving soldiers. 
Defeat #rDinogoths#k in #b#m401030000##k, gather the tails, and return to #rHarpoon#k in #b#m401000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: You got the tails from the Dinogoths. Now there are plenty for the soldiers.

0.0: Food rationing was necessary while supplies to the Reclamation HQ were cut off. As a result, the soliders are very hungry. Before new supplies come in through the re-opened supply route, it would be great if you could get some extra #brations for the soldiers#k.
0.1: Around #b10 Dinogoth Tails#k will help the soldiers. Could you get them?\r\n#e#r* If you accept, you will move to the field.#k\r\n

yes.0: You'll find #rDinogoth#k monsters near HQ on the #bPath to the Hill#k. I'll get some more bookkeeping done in the meantime. Be careful.

no.0: Supplies are the key to victory! Won't you reconsider?

1.0: One, two, three...this should be perfect. There's plenty to go around. Thanks! We'll finally be having our fill today.

yes.0: We still need more supplies, but I can do a lot with this meat. Extra tasty is good for morale!

item.0: Around #b10 Dinogoth Tails#k will fill up the soldiers. Could you get them? #rDinogoth#k monsters are on the #bPath to the Hill#k near HQ.
